comment: The macOS Metal build's source manifest and upstream contract (tools/metal_manifest.py).
Upstream is ChupathingyCE (https://github.com/ChupathingyCE/chupathingyce); its platform layer is port/linux/src.
Every .c in port/linux/src is classified exactly once: shared (compiled unchanged), replaced (by a Mac file) or dropped.
Every source and header under port/macos/metal/{xbox_compat,shaders,platform,renderer} is listed exactly once.

'base' pins the upstream git blob a Mac fork was last reconciled with; 'seen' (optional) an upstream blob whose changes are acknowledged but not yet reconciled. 'identical' copies must match upstream byte for byte.
Initial historical base pins are content-history estimates, not a claim that every intervening change was reviewed or ported; seen keeps the current known backlog visible.
After reviewing an upstream change: python3 tools/metal_manifest.py accept <upstream file>.

d3d8_gl.c.why: The Xbox D3D8 device: the same D3DDevice_* entry points, translated to the Metal backend (renderer/gpu.h) instead of OpenGL.

d3d8_resources.c.why: Byte-identical, but its #include "xgpu.h" must find the Metal xgpu.h beside it, not OpenGL's beside the upstream copy.

xgpu_text.c.why: Byte-identical, but its #include "xgpu.h" must find the Metal xgpu.h beside it, not OpenGL's beside the upstream copy.

xbox_textures.c.why: Xbox texture decoding and caching, uploaded through the Metal backend; per-stage texture lookup cache.

nv2a_vsh.c.why: NV2A vertex programs translated to MSL (with shaders/nv2a_msl.c) instead of GLSL; per-pixel lighting recognition.

nv2a_psh.c.why: NV2A register combiners translated to MSL instead of GLSL.

sdl_platform.c.why: A Metal window (SDL_WINDOW_METAL): no OpenGL context, swap interval or GL entry points.

port_config.c.why: The Metal renderer's settings (debug.metal_*, display.* that only Metal reads).

menu_files.c.why: Menu art as backend textures (gpu_texture_*) instead of GL textures.

ui_overlay.c.why: The overlay drawn into the Metal back buffer (renderer/metal_overlay.inc) instead of with GL calls.

hud_hires.c.why: High-resolution HUD textures uploaded through the Metal backend.

text_hires.c.why: The high-resolution text atlas as a backend texture instead of a GL texture.

xgpu_post.c.why: OpenGL FXAA/SMAA passes; the Metal backend has its own (renderer/metal_post.inc, renderer/metal_smaa.inc).

xgpu_shader_cache.c.why: GLSL program cache; Metal keeps pipelines in a binary archive and warms shader lists (renderer/gpu_metal.m).

shared.comment: Compiled unchanged into the Metal build (with the Mac include directories first).

headers.comment: Mac headers that shadow upstream headers of the same name for every unit in the Metal build.

xgpu.h.why: The front end's internals over renderer/gpu.h instead of OpenGL.

platform.h.why: Adds the Metal front-end hooks (platform_renderer_metal, platform_fixed_timestep).

port_config.h.why: Byte-identical; kept beside port_config.c so its quoted include stays inside the fork.

hud_hires.h.why: Backend texture handles instead of GL names.

text_hires.h.why: Comment and declaration differences that follow text_hires.c.

mac_only.comment: Sources (and headers) with no upstream counterpart.

sources.xbox_compat/xbox_state.c: Cached Xbox render/texture-stage state to backend state (depth, blend, raster, samplers, pixel shader).
sources.shaders/nv2a_msl.c: Metal Shading Language output for the NV2A translators.
sources.renderer/gpu_dispatch.c: The gpu_* entry points (renderer/gpu.h) bound to the Metal backend.
sources.platform/metal_compat.c: Platform hooks the native macOS port does not need (fixed timestep, input replay).
sources.platform/mono.c: Stereo queries answered for one ordinary view.

tools.renderer/metal_smoke.m: ninja macos-metal-smoke: a standalone backend check, not part of the game.

not_provided.comment: Symbols the upstream files above define that the Metal build deliberately does not.
not_provided.xgpu_compile_shader: GLSL compilation (d3d8_gl.c); Metal compiles MSL in renderer/gpu_metal.m.
not_provided.xgpu_link_program: GLSL program linking (d3d8_gl.c); Metal pipelines in renderer/gpu_metal.m.
not_provided.xgpu_gl_state_invalidate: OpenGL state tracking (d3d8_gl.c); the Metal encoder state cache is renderer/metal_state_cache.h.
not_provided.nv2a_vertex_shader_to_glsl: GLSL output (nv2a_vsh.c); Metal's is nv2a_vertex_shader_translate with shaders/nv2a_msl.c.
not_provided.nv2a_pixel_shader_to_glsl: GLSL output (nv2a_psh.c); Metal's is nv2a_pixel_shader_translate with shaders/nv2a_msl.c.
not_provided.platform_video_swap: GL buffer swap (sdl_platform.c); Metal presents in renderer/gpu_metal.m.
not_provided.ui_overlay_present: GL overlay drawing (ui_overlay.c); Metal draws it in renderer/metal_overlay.inc.
not_provided.hud_hires_settings: CONFIRMED GAP: upstream 3bfb63b17 invalidates cached HUD/title-art replacements on live setting changes. The Metal CPU integration probe fails both toggle directions; font enable checks pass. See docs/metal-compatibility-gaps.md. Remove this exception when the missing contract is implemented.
